verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Salesforce ships marketplace access ('Access to AgentExchange') as part of Sales Cloud packaging, consistent with an app-marketplace model for prebuilt integrations, but the pack contains no detail on the specific integration categories named in the story (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) or on installation flow/experience. Missing for 10: named connectors for Slack/support desk/marketing/data warehouse, install/setup walkthrough, independent hands-on confirmation of marketplace installs.
